accessrestrict.head: Conditions Governing Access
accessrestrict.p: Open for research. Brittle or damaged items are available at the discretion of RAC.

arrangement.head: Arrangement
arrangement.p: Original order, as received. Arranged in series by record type.

processinfo.head: Processing Information
processinfo.p: Expedited Access - Processing Level 0 - Initial Access.
Rather than a file-level guide, the description provided is a broad representation of contents intended to facilitate discovery and initial open access to the collection.
Records remain in original housing. Additional processing will be conducted in the future to improve description, enhance access, and long-term preservation.

scopecontent.head: Scope and Contents
scopecontent.p: The Social Science Research Council archives are comprised of committee and working group files, program and planning files, meeting records, research materials, fellowship and grant admininistration records, area studies, chronological files, correspondence, as well as planning, preparation and associated drafts and products of sponsored workshops, conferences, and seminars.
